architecture: encoder.0: Conv2d(1->16, kernel=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), bias=True)
encoder.2: Conv2d(16->32, kernel=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), bias=True)
decoder.2: ConvTranspose2d(32->16, kernel=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), output_padding=(1, 1), bias=True)
decoder.4: ConvTranspose2d(16->1, kernel=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), output_padding=(1, 1), bias=True)

fixed.init: PyTorch default layer init, built on CPU after set_seed()
fixed.loss: pixelwise MSE, mean over batch and 784 pixels
fixed.numerics: float32; TF32 disabled; cuDNN deterministic, benchmark off
fixed.selection: restore epoch with the lowest validation MSE
fixed.shuffle: torch.randperm on the CPU generator, once per epoch, last partial batch kept
fixed.validation: shared 6K split from data.load_data() unless X_val is passed explicitly
